Once each spring, it is allowed for all Amazons of any caste to mate with men so that new daughters can be born. Do you wish to host a fertility ritual, and put your captive male population to good use?
Yes, let the ritual be prepared!
No, maybe next year...

Rigg, Goddess of War and Battle does not normally tolerate men in her realm, but tonight her sister Serena will allow an exception. The drums beat, the pace of the dance increases, and as the wine flows, your ceremonial husband for one night is brought before you in chains along with many others for your gathered sisters. You may do as you wish with him and if he does not please you, the Snake-Goddess Serena will welcome his sacrifice after he has performed his final duty for the Amazon Sisterhood!
Come with me, slave...

While lying in the prison cell you hear the drums beat, the pace of the dance increases, the laughter upstairs in the palace grow increasingly wild as the wine no doubt flows. Fierce Amazon spearmaidens soon arrive to put you in chains and drag up to the hall along with the others. You are soon brought before an Amazon Priestess, and she leads you towards her private quarters... you have heard rumours that men who displease them during the fertility rites are sacrificed, so your heart is pumping out of your chest...
Must ... not... disappoint her!

You wake up with a smile on your face, sighing contentedly. The slave performed well last night, and you are inclined to let him live on. Yet on the other hand, Serena favours those who sacrifice in her name... especially things they place value on.
Another time perhaps. For now, this one lives.
A life for a life, Serena will have his blood!
You wake up with a sneer awoken by the slave's snoring, still tied to your bed. You remember his pathetic performance last night, and the blood lust begins to boil in your veins...
No, I'm going to be merciful.
At least I'll enjoy sacrificing this one, and hearing his screams.
You wake up tied to the Priestess's bed, and find her smiling down on you. 'Good slave,' she whispers, 'I hope the others let you live too, and I get you next year as well...'
Thank the gods, I'm going to live!

You wake up tied to the Priestess's bed, and find her sneering face looking down on you. Without a word, you are knocked unconscious by the hilt of a wicked looking dagger and when you come to... you are in the great hall, kneeling before the high priestess. Drums are beating, your head is pounding, Amazons are dancing and cheering behind you, and then a sharp cold pain is felt against your throat. You have no time to scream as the last things you see is a spray of blood pouring out on the ground from your throat!
Ugghhhh!!!

The sacrifices to Serena are brought before the throne. These men have proven themselves worthless. The drums are beating, your sisters are dancing around them, and cheers emanate from the sides of the great hall. Finally you step down behind the slave you bedded last night, savour the look of terror on his face, and then swiftly draw the sacrificial dagger as you move behind him and spray his lifeblood all over the floor. The Creators be praised, let this sacrifice please the Snake-Goddess!
Serena be praised!

Curse this unjust and purely socially constructed order!

I will plead for it at once.
The land of [From.Location.GetName] is scourged by a massive Beastmen infestation. Your subjects have pleaded many times for you to fund an expedition to cleanse them.
Sounds reasonable.
We cannot spare anything for this.
Your soldiers did their job and exterminated every last one of the Beastmen still scourging your land.
Good.
The expedition had catastrophic results: not only the Beastmen repelled your forces, the battle has sent them into a frenzy, if they gain further momentum, they might turn into a full horde.
We must prepare ourselves!

The Ruinous Powers have touched you holding and their presence has been made apparent on your newborn [GetFromRelation]. The infant has come to life deformed, screeching from a beast's mouth. Many in your court demand for the creature to be burned immediately.

The gods have blessed your household, your newborn [GetFromRelation] shows their favour in [From.GetHerHis] proud animalistic features. Yet there are some in the court claiming the child's place is not in this world.

The Hrrrd'stone! Brnng them to th'GODS!

Hmpf.
You are the ruler of a Bretonnian castle, and you - like the rest of your fellow rulers - are an ordained Knight of the Realm.

You are a skilled warrior, and it is time you took up your duties to the realm and became a Knight Errant of Bretonnia. It is your duty to seek out dangerous threats and conquer them in the name of the Lady.
You are a knight of Bretonnia, it is only fitting that you travel the land doing great deeds, rescuing maidens and slaying monsters. Will you take up the questing life?
I return home to heal - For the Lady!
You have become wounded, and can no longer carry on the questing life. It is time to return to your castle and regain your strength.

You are a knight of Bretonnia, but only the most noble and pure knights are worthy to sip from the Holy Grail of the Lady of the Lake. Do you want to test yourself on this great - but also dangerous, quest?
Simple peasants - so that's where my tax money went!

You come across a remote shrine, dedicated to a sighting of the Lady many years ago. Naturally you leave an offering to help maintain the shrine, but as you prepare to leave a local headman boldly asks you for a further donation to the help feed the local village.
Away with that, temptress! Just water for me from now on.
I could indulge myself just once more...

You are not the purest or most abstinent of knights, so life is a daily challenge to meet the lofty ideals you hold. One night you and your retinue arrive in a decent tavern to rest after your latest efforts, and soon after you take a seat a barmaid arrives to serve. Tired and deprived, you feel especially appreciative at the sight of the pitcher of wine balanced on her hip, and her warm inviting smile...
*restrain yourself* Be on your way, peasant...
I'll horsewhip you from here to Cathay, you foul peasant!

While passing through the countryside, you proceed past a filthy family of mud-scrabbling peasants. They drop their loads and fall to the ground with eyes averted as you pass by, but you can hardly believe it when one particularly malodorous one looks you directly in the eye!
Well met, Sir Knight! I am ready for the challenge!

You can't believe it... one day while riding in the woods, the Green Knight appears. This is the final test! If you prove worthy and defeat him, the Lady of the Lake will appear and allow you to sip from the Holy Grail!

It... it's finally happening! The Lady of the Lake appears before you, her grace and beauty beyond compare. Purified from your trials she allows you to sip from the Grail, and you feel vitality and strength flow into you!
You have become maimed, and can no longer carry on the questing life. It is time to return to your castle, and focus on strengthening your own lands with the rest of your strength.
I care nothing for what my vassals think!
Yes, I rule with the Lady's Blessing.
No, but I will continue questing for it!
I care nothing for what my vassals think!
Seven years have passed - have you become a Grail Knight?
Rumours reach you that the new ruler of Bretonnia has succeeded in the Grail Quest, and now rules with the blessing of the Lady of the Lake.

Rumours reach you that the new ruler of Bretonnia has failed in his Grail Quest, but has decided to rule on without the blessing of the Lady of the Lake. This is almost certain to start a civil war in that realm...
Rumours reach you that the new ruler of Bretonnia is having difficulty completing his grail quest, but is still determined to quest on until he succeeds.
No, I seek greater glories than mere trolls!

While searching for local challenges, you come across an unusual story. Sheep and peasants have gone missing, and despite repeated punishments the shepherds insist they are not lacking in their duties. They claim a foul beast, as tall as a house and reeking like a tannery lurks in the hills, periodically emerging to devour whatever it can catch. After some conference with your retainers you determine it could very well be a troll! Do you want to investigate?

It... it's finally happening! The Lady of the Lake appears before you, her grace and beauty beyond compare. She let's you sip from the grail, but it is not the invigorating and life changing experience you had heard it would be. But, surely you feel... something?
I... I think I feel a little more holy now?
It was the true holy grail, it must have been!
No, this isn't right. I must continue questing!
There have been some doubts cast on your vision of the Lady and the Holy Grail. You do not have the aura that other grail knights have, nor did the Green Knight appear to challenge you.
They weren't there - it happened! Maybe the Grail is simply different for each man?

Rumours reach you that the new ruler of Bretonnia has supposedly completed his grail quest, but there are doubts as to whether or not it was the real Grail. This will make his rule a troubled one, no doubt.

Several former Knight Errants have recently returned home after completing their questing duties, and they bring news most grave. Your child, [From.GetTitledFirstName], was killed by a group of beastmen during an extremely dangerous mission in southern Bretonnia. They assure you that [From.GetSheHe] faced the foul beasts with bravery and tried [From.GetHerHis] best before [From.GetSheHe] was killed by their overwhelming number.
My son... he died a hero...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from his quest as Knight Errant as a changed being. [From.GetSheHe] is more ambitious and more knowledgeable in matters of war. It seems the time spent as a Knight Errant did [From.GetHerHim] good.
Did you bring any riches home with you?

After many years in service, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has finally finshed his duties as a as Knight Errant and returned home. Your child is a changed being, however. [From.GetSheHe] now spends whole afternoons drinking, and stinks of ale, no longer listening to your fatherly advices.
I knew something bad was going to happen!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has finally returned home after a long and successful journey as Knight Errant! [From.GetSheHe] learned much from his battles against the enemies of the Lady and Bretonnia, alongside fellow knights!.
Tell me about your missions!
After many years in service, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has finally left the Fighter's Guild and returned home. Your child is a changed being, however. [From.GetSheHe] stinks of .
I knew something bad was going to happen!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has returned from his duties as a Knight Errant, but [From.GetSheHe] refuses to speak of [From.GetHerHis] experiences during them. You know [From.GetSheHe] took part in several battles and killed uncountable bandits, beastmen and orcs, but instead of reveling in the glory of [From.GetHerHis] accomplishments, [From.GetFirstName] is plagued by nightmares and jumps at sudden sounds.
Strange...
column3: Strange...

column2: A mysterious knight clad in strange armor approaches your throne, and before [From.GetSheHe] can be contained, the strange warrior relieves your guard of [From.GetHerHis] spear in a swift, fluid motion and tosses it aside. Other guards hurry forward, but you raise your hand to stop them. The stranger is [From.GetTitledFirstName], at last returned from his duties as Knight Errant!
[From.GetFirstName]! You've... changed!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has come back from his duties as Knight Errant, but [From.GetSheHe] is not alone. [From.GetSheHe] has saved a nobleborn lady during his quests and brought her with him. Though of a lesser noble bloodline, this woman seems to be of a perfect breed, a nice addition to our lineage!
To each [From.GetHerHis] own

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has at last returned from his Errantry Tour with a carriage filled with the spoils of [From.GetHerHis] quests! Apparently being a Knight Errant is very profitable business. Your child insists on sharing these riches with you, [From.GetHerHis] loving father.
[From.GetFirstName], you make me proud!

A frail, robed character is led into your throne room, and your guards explain that [From.GetSheHe] just arrived on a carriage. The character would only speak your name over and over again, and so [From.GetSheHe] was brought to you. To your horror, you recognize [From.GetHerHim] at last as [From.GetTitledFirstName]!
My son, what has happened to you!?

Upon learning of the death of your father, you left your Errantry Tour and departed for home on a carriage filled with gold from your glorious accomplishments. It was a long and perilous journey back, but your feet are now firmly planted on the soil of the land that is your birthright. The throne is yours.
It's a sad moment. But it's good to finally be back home.

Your child, [From.GetTitledFirstName], has decided to set out on an Errantry Tour in order to prove [From.GetHerHis] his honour as a true Bretonnian! Although [From.GetSheHe] will no doubt gain both glory and valuable battle experience as a Knight Errant, there will be many dangerous quests that could well cost [From.GetHerHis] life.
Go forth, son, for the Lady!
I will not allow it!

The camp was attacked last night. It seems the besieged are growing desperate with their tactics. Most of the men were caught by surprise but not you... you were not only ready to fight, but rallied some men around you and excelled during in combat. A deed worthy of a Knight of the Realm!
The enemy is flanking! You rallied some men around you and organized a great counter-charge, breaking the flanking enemies. A deed worthy of a Knight of the Realm!
Finally, some recognition of my abilities. For the Lady and the King!
May the Lady guide my path!
The Finals
You were able to make it into the finals. Although, the tournament and its ups and downs, you feel ready to win the whole thing!
I will be victorious!

You were able to make it into the finals. The tournament favourite [From.GetTitledFirstName] made it into the finals as expected. All eyes will be fixated on you and the monster they call [From.GetFirstNameWithNick].
Time to fight fate.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] dodged your strike and rushed in from the side. [From.GetTitledFirstName] managed to strike you with a swift and powerful blow.

I have been knocked off my horse.

For sixty days, you and the greatest warriors of [TopLiege.Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName] have been giving your all in the arena. Every melee you have won will mean nothing, if you were to fall right now. This one final clash will determine your position in the history books.

One on one, the stage is set, this is your moment.
The glory will be mine!

Money!

column2: Daemon Hunt
Quest to become Chosen
Quest to become Champion
Quest to become Chosen, the first step on the path to ruin!
Quest to become Champion, the next step on the path to ruin!
Chosen are minor champions that have won small favours from their gods, you may quest to become one yourself.
Yes, I shall earn favour from the gods!
Chosen Duel

The gods have heard your plea, and have answered. Following the instructions delivered in the entrails of your servant, you find yourself in a twisted grove of otherworldly trees. A hulking beast of malformed flesh and bone claws its way through to the clearing and roars a challenge to you. You're not sure if it's a former champion who succumbed to their corruption, or some unfortunate beast that was twisted by the gods, but it's definitely hostile. Defeat the creature, and gain your infamy!
Charge! For the Dark Gods!
Perhaps I will come back later?
Victory!

The beast is huge and possesses immense strength, but is slow and witless. It is a simple matter to dodge the clumsy blows and strike it repeatedly as it bellows and lurches at you. Finally, after countless strikes, the creature lets out a forlorn cry and collapses in a pool of its own blood. You emerge victorious, and thus may be granted your gift from the gods...
I am the greatest!
Failure!

You thought you had won, but your smugness turns to horror when the monster's fury increases and catches you off guard in a careless moment. Now, you lie in a pool of blood, becoming a meal, not a Chosen.
No! Not... Not like this!
Quest Finished

After returning home from your victory, word has spread of your deed, now a band of hopeful warriors has arrived at your hold, pledging service to you as their rightful leader. They expect you to lead them to greater glories and triumphs.
Good... Now on to grander things...
Worship Chaos Undivided
Why keep worshipping only one chaos god, when you know the power of Chaos Undivided
Worship Khorne
The Lord of Skulls has clearly shown his favour towards you. Why keep worshipping the other weaklings?
Worship Nurgle
Papa Nurgle has clearly shown his love towards you. Why keep worshipping the other gods?
Worship Tzeentch
Clearly, the Architect of Fate has a special destiny in store for you. Why keep worshipping the lesser gods?
Worship Slaanesh
The Prince of Pleasure has shown... interest in your talents. Why not worship her beauty above all the other gods?
This act will greatly please the Chaos God you'll dedicate to, but the other 3 will consider it a great offense.
A Sacrifice to Hashut
A Sacrifice to Hashut
A level of Slave Levy will be added to [Root.Capital.GetName]

You bring [From.GetTitledFirstName] to [Root.Capital.GetName]'s slave markets in order to be sold to the highest bidder. [From.GetFirstName] will be sold into slavery and will be functionally dead.\nThe higher the base stats of the slave, the more gold you'll get for selling [From.GetHerHim]...

Outside of the plains of Zharrduk, the Great Tauruses can only be found in their natural habitats, inside the calderas of active volcanoes. You have managed to convince one of the Bull Centaurs guarding [From.Capital.GetName]'s temple to snatch a young calf from one of the nearby volcanoes. The beast will be fully grown and magically bound in 5 years.
Born To His Own Nature
Born To His Own Nature
Born To His Own Nature
Born To His Own Nature

One of your sons has undergone his Svabhaavajam and has assumed the features of his caste. With his brown skin and small size it is clear that he has become one of the Shearl, the craftsmen and laborers of Fimir society.

One of your sons has undergone his Svabhaavajam and has assumed the features of his caste. With his green skin and his fast growth it is clear that he is one of the Fimm, the warriors of Fimir society.

One of your sons has undergone his Svabhaavajam and has assumed the features of his caste. With his skin darkening and his immense size it is clear that he has become one of the Nobles, the military leaders of Fimir society

One of your sons has undergone his Svabhaavajam and has assumed the features of his caste. With his yellow skin and with his horns beginning to grow in early he it is clear that he is one of the Dirach, the sorcerors of Fimir society and the highest caste of male fimir.
I will need to find a good teacher for him...
The clan grows one stronger today.
A worthy successor.
The Dark Gods have truly blessed us!
Who carez about 'da vamps, we krump 'em eazy!
A great horde of [Root.Culture.GetName]s haz come to scrap unda your WAAAGH! banna! Dey can't waitz to start krumpin' ur enemies!
We'z gunna stomp 'em good!
Da boss of a smalla [Root.Culture.GetName] horde haz come to da camp! He'z 'eard of da great WAAAGH! you'z iz makin' and want'z ta join ya!
He can join, but I'z da boss! we'z gunna zogg 'em good now!
A smalla horde of [Root.Culture.GetName]s wantz to fight unda da WAAAGH! banna! Dey say dey can 'elp ya zogg da gits!
We'z da best, and dey know'z it!

OI! Boss! While plunderin' da boyz found a bigg droppin' in [From.Location.GetName] wiv da face ov [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] in it! [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] favaas you'z!

Come 'ere boyz! We'z gonna get really mean!
OI! Boss! All da boyz in [Root.GetName] are startin' to drezz an' yap jus' like ya!
Datz more like it, boyz!
Cursed creatures!
This province is infested by a massive Greenskin population. It is only right that your liege funds an expedition to cleanse it from these troublesome pests.
I will plead for it at once.
Dis 'ere land of [Root.Location.GetName] has been made green by da boys! Now, all da fawmer 'oldings built by runtz are rebuilt in da propa way!
Da boys 'ave found a droppin' in [Root.Location.GetName] wiv da face ov [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName] in it! [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] favaaahrs us!
A Great Ball
Lovers
Seduction
Grief
Your top liege is a servant of the gods, and will not tolerate you in his realm. It is better to flee now, rather than to risk destruction at the hands of the Witch Hunters...
Agreed, I must leave at once!

Lizardmen do not reproduce as other mortals do. Instead, generations of Lizardmen emerge from the vast spawning pools beneath their great temple-cities, fully formed. Some of these spawnings are predetermined by the Great Plan, but at other times, especially when the need is greatest, spawnings may occur suddenly and unexpectedly.

Lizardmen do not reproduce as other mortals do. Instead, generations of Lizardmen emerge from the vast spawning pools beneath their great temple-cities, fully formed. Some of these spawnings are predetermined by the Great Plan, but at other times, especially when the need is greatest, spawnings may occur suddenly and unexpectedly.
Welcome, your fate is to birth a new generation of Lizardmen and die.
Welcome, you are [Root.GetFullName].

After centuries of gestation, a new Lizardman emerges from the spawning pools.\nHaving consulted the alignment of the stars and the position of the moon, the Skink Priests determine that [FromFrom.GetSubjectPronoun] shall be named [FromFrom.GetBestName].
The Winds of Chaos are strong.

Since the Great Catastrophe, the world has been tainted by the mark of Chaos. The immense power and attunement to magic of the Slann makes their minds vulnerable, and when they awaken from their deep contemplation, their spirits become clouded by unreason and uncertainty.
[This.GetName] is now part of the Lustrian jungles.
Adds Lustrian Jungle to the Lustrian Jungle and should be invisible.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetBestName] has has died from a serious disease [From.GetSubjectPronoun] caught in the jungles of Lustria.

The vast majority of Lustria is covered in jungle so thick that its many levels of canopy block out the sky. Even the high peaks and plateaus are blanketed, and it is said that arboreal creatures can cross the entire continent without once stepping upon the ground. In places, the trees soar many hundreds of feet in the air and some are even older than the race of humans.
Remove recent_sleep_change flag.

The province where the jungle is to be cut back is decided by the location of your [Root.GetTreasurerName] [Root.job_treasurer.GetBestName]. However, [Root.job_treasurer.GetSheHe] is currently in [Root.job_treasurer.Location.GetName], which is not one of your demesne province, or you have been cutting back the jungle recently there.
DEBUG: This event puts you in the FROM scope for Lustrian jungle cut-backing.
DEBUG: Kill creature after duel, even if it lives.
DEBUG: Province ping event for Lustrian jungle-cutbacking.
§Y[From.GetBestName]§! has been killed by rampaging reptiles.
[GetRandomGodNameCap] be praised!
Some years have passed since the last change
This event should be hidden.

One of your enemies has been foolish enough to try and destroy you. Their actions may have incapacitated you, for a time, but the ancient magic protecting your soul is already at work to bring you back into the land of the living.

One of your enemies has been foolish enough to try and destroy you. Their actions may have incapacitated you, for a time, but the ancient magic protecting your soul is already at work to return you to your full strength.
I will rise again!
Nothing can kill me!
Through the spells of the Liche Priests and your divine willpower, you've returned, your dessicated body whole again, ready to cast dominion across all that you see.
Through the spells of your sorceresses and your own willpower, you've returned, your body whole again, ready to cast dominion across all that you see.
Rise, my soldiers!
At last, vengeance shall be mine!!
Your soldiers have returned with rich treasures from the ancient tombs of Nehekhara. Though there was resistance from the local undead, your expedition has bore some results.
All mine!
The blasphemous raiders of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have dared to scour your lands, stealing the ancient treasure hidden within the ancient halls of your glorious palaces.
Revenge!!
The blasphemous raiders of [From.GetTitledFirstName] have dared to scour [FromFrom.GetName], stealing the ancient treasure hidden within your own palaces.
Revenge!!
[From.GetName] was hiding a marvellous treasure. Scouring the desert allowed your men to return with loads gold, relics and precious stones.
All mine!
The accursed Tomb Kings of Nehekhara have cursed you for desecrating their tombs. Your army is faltering, crumbling under the arcane sickness bestowed unto them, as are your very limbs.
No! Put it back! Put it back!
You've suffered for too long as a prisoner of this unworthy mortal. Though your body may be tied and your servants far away, your wrath shall strike your jailer and punish them for their blasphemy.
So it shall be.
You thought you could lock away an immortal King of Nehekhara with impunity, but [From.GetSheHe] has cast ruination upon you, greying your skin and rotting the bones beneath your flesh.
Nooo!!

One of the pretenders has tried to lock you away, far from the throne that rightfully belongs to you. But there are still many servants you could reach with your mind. Slowly, your retainers made their way to your dungeon and allowed you to escape.
Free at last.

The pretender you decided to lock away has managed to call upon [From.GetHerHis] loyal servants and found a way to sneak away from your dungeons, to plot [From.GetHerHis] campaign for Nehekhara once more.
Bah!
The Nehekkan tribes in [Root.GetName] will no longer stand for your oppressive rule and have decided to rise up against you.
Useless vagrants!
The Nehekkan tribes in [From.GetName] will no longer stand for your oppressive rule and have decided to rise up against your vassal.
Useless vagrants!
A Nehekkan tribe has sent word to ask permission to freely roam within the province of [Root.GetName].
They are free to stay.
I won't allow this.
No vagrant shall ever put foot in this province for as long as I rule.
Emissaries from the tribe of desert dwellers you allowed inside [Root.GetName] have been sent to your court, asking for supplies in a period of shortage for their chiefs.
Just settle down in this land.
We can spare something.
Get lost, you filthy beggars!

For weeks you've received complaints from your subjects regarding the undead troops roaming across your lands on your liege's command. There has been no attack, but the people are unsettled by the skeletons standing sometimes for days, staring at their homes.
I'll talk with their master.
Just pretend they're not there.

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent a complaint about your troops. Apparently the glorious armies of Nehekhara stationed to protect [From.GetHerHis] province are unsettling the locals.
I command them to fall back and change their path.
I command them to reassure the locals of their good intentions.
This is no concern of us.

Luckily [From.GetTitledFirstName] seems to understand the problem and has had [From.GetHerHis] undead troops discretely fall back, pursuing less exposed patrols, hopefully placating the fears of the living.
Good to hear.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent an envoy to thank you for your wisdom regarding the issue of your troops scaring [From.GetHerHis] subjects.
I still don't see what was scary about them.

Unfortunately, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has ruled otherwise on your plea to retreat some of the undead from your countryside. In fact, there are now frequent reports of people scared away from the province by skeletons trying to speak with them in hissing voices and dead languages.
What are they doing?!

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetTitledFirstName] is still unsatisfied with your solution to the problem of the craven subjects in [From.GetHerHis] provinces. The living keep on mistrusting and shying away, despite your servants' attempts at reassuring them.
Are they hiding something?

You thought the worst when receiving news of the undead approaching directly your subjects, but, astonishingly enough, your people managed to find common ground with the creatures and are starting to get along fine with each other, trusting the immortal soldiers to be ever-watchful over their land and possessions.
Who'd have thought?
Just as you assumed, it was only a question of showing the integrity and discipline of Nehekharan troops to reassure the people under [From.GetTitledFirstName].
It's obvious.
The response of [From.GetTitledFirstName] was the same as that of [From.GetHerHis] soldier: silence. You keep on receiving complaints about your subjects, but there's not really much you can do.
Why they have to be so creepy?
Your vassal finally stopped with [From.GetHerHis] meaningless complaints about your soldiers scaring the local populace. After all, if they've done nothing wrong, what do they have to fear about?
Indeed.

Since you can remember you've heard incredible and terrible stories about your liege lord and the palace of immortal corpses they live in. Now that there's an opportunity to travel there, you're not sure you want to.
I'm not scared!
Maybe when I'm older...

Amongst the visitors from the lands of the living under your rule, you've been surprised to see a strange creature. Although covered in flesh, it is smaller than any being you remember, be it human, dwarf or halfling, with short limbs and big eyes.
I shall speak with [From.GetHerHim].
A creature so small has to be meaningless.

The tall and dessicated undead, wrapped in golden robes, is finally in front of you and starts speaking in a strange and hissing voice, despite [From.GetHerHis] mouth hanging still. The creature leans forward, as if [From.GetSheHe] was about to grab you.
H-Hello! How do you do?
*Fight back!*
*Flee*

Not only you discovered to your surprise that the creature is in fact your vassal, [From.GetSheHe] explained you that [From.GetSheHe] is a child, that's why [From.GetSheHe] is so small. That still sounds strange, you don't remember ever being like that, even when alive.
At least [From.GetSheHe] can talk properly.
In the end the undead just wanted to talk with you, [From.GetSheHe] didn't mean any harm and looked just surprised to know you are a kid.
Just for now, though!
The creature was more dangerous than you realized. When you tried to approach it and see what it was, it screamed something and attacked you, shortly after running away with one of your sacred ribs.
Come back here!
The undead guards are still looking for you, but you think they'll be more busy recovering the trophy you snatched from [From.GetHerHis] ribcage to worry about you getting out of this tomb.
I still showed [From.GetHerHim]!
At your very sight the little creature started twitching and, before you could even say something, it was running away, screaming with an high-pitched voice.
What the...?
Luckily, you managed to save yourself from the evil undead before it could suck your soul. You'll never return to this cursed tomb.
Never!
Don't know why, maybe because of the lack of eyes, but the undead lord has ignored you for all the time you've been in [From.GetHerHis] palace.
Maybe it's for the best.
You've suffered a great shortage of water this year, with many oasis running low or dry. You've tried to plead to your undead overlords, but they've been silent for the most part.
I'll ask directly to my liege.
It's no use.

You've received word from one of your Nehekkan vassals. [From.GetTitledFirstName] for some strange reason is asking for a great deal of water for [From.GetHerHim]self and [From.GetHerHis] subjects. You do remember water had no flavour for the living either, so you're not sure why [From.GetSheHe] would need any...
If they want to damp themselves, let them.
This is nonsense.
Fortunately your liege has seen the desperate needs of your tribe and has sent some of [From.GetHerHis] servants to gather water for your subjects.
The gods be praised!
Unfortunately your liege has been as silent as [From.GetHerHis] servants and refused to give any help in the search for water.
We'll find something eventually...

You remember enjoying being at a table with friends, partaking in the fruits of the land, when you were alive. Yet all food tastes like ash and all wine like sand. There's no pleasure in feasting and no joy in conversation. Your servants are silent and empty, your lords envious pretenders of past and future generations.
I hate this!
This is just too sad...

You still have some memories of the days when you were alive, the anger, the passion... Yet all is still and cold now. You rule jointly with another pretender, maybe your new wife could be interested in trying to relive what was like to love a man, however rotten be his corpse?

You still have some memories of the days when you were alive, the anger, the passion... Yet all is still and cold now. You rule jointly with another pretender, maybe your new husband could be interested in trying to relive what was like to love a woman, however rotten be her corpse?
Worth a try.
It doesn't matter. I'm past that.

For some weeks now the pretender you decided to rule along with has started making some strange pressures. You're unsure what could be achieved: besides hardly remembering what's supposed to be done, you're pretty sure whatever you would need are rotting in a canopic jar who knows where...

For some weeks now the pretender you decided to rule along with has started making some strange pressures. You're unsure what could be achieved: besides hardly remembering what's supposed to be done, the embalmed and desiccated corpse you 'live' with is not the most inviting creature you'd want to touch.
Let's give it a try.
We're beyond this.
Despite your best efforts, your spouse doesn't seem to be interested in the least in exploring the old boundaries of marriage.
Despite your best efforts, your spouse doesn't seem to be interested in the least in exploring the old boundaries of marriage.
Why not?! Can we not feel alive again?
You were glad to hear your [GetFromRelation] shares in your curiosity and is eager to try alongside you.
You were glad to hear your [GetFromRelation] shares in your curiosity and is eager to try alongside you.
Let's get started!

Your [GetFromRelation] tried his best, but there was not much to go around with in the first place. A lot of awkward rattling and creaking, faked hissing wailing and dead emotionless gazes. Maybe it wasn't such a great idea...

After last night, whatever memory was left of your past life's sexual experience has gone. In its place a disturbing cacophony of creaking joints, bones and desiccated flesh rubbing on each other and lipless mouths clashing together.

After last night, whatever memory was left of your past life's sexual experience has gone. In its place a disgusting cacophony of creaking joints, bones and desiccated flesh rubbing on each other and lipless mouths clashing together.
I could puke if I still had a stomach.

You're not sure if what you did with your [GetFromRelation] last night was exactly how the living do. You had to get more imaginative to make up for the missing body parts, but still, it was not bad at all.

Incantation of Awakening

You have roused your faithful Liche Priests in hopes of awakening one of your Ancestors, and as they are preparing for the ritual you have been left to wander which Ancestor should you Awaken from their Eternal Slumber...
Incantation of Awakening has been completed for [new_tomb_king.GetFirstName] of the House [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName]
Awaken my Gracious Father
Awaken my Despotic Father
Awaken my Scheming Father
Awaken my Majestic Father
Awaken my Indomitable Ancestor
Awaken my Gracious Grandfather
Awaken my Tyrannical Grandfather
Awaken my Scheming Grandfather
Awaken my Honorable Grandfather
Awaken one of my Diplomatic Relatives
Awaken one of my Militant Relatives
Awaken one of my Clever Relatives
Awaken one of my Relatives
Glory to Our Eternal Dynasty!

You are one of the tomb kings of Nehekhara, a powerful ruler of a long-dead realm whose glories have long since faded. Yet still you endure, still you stand guard over the ancient glories of the past, and perhaps - the future glories yet to come.
I serve forever, even in death.

You are one of the Liche Priests of Nehekhara, a powerful priest watching over the Tomb Kings and their treasures. Your oath compels you to serve eternally, even in death, to advance the desires of your immortal god-kings.

Your dynasty stretches back thousands of years, but most of the ancient kings and queens of your line are asleep in their great tombs. It is time to awaken some of them, so that if you should perish, they can take up the rule of your lands.
You recieve news that a massive white whale has been sinking your whaling vessels and is disrupting your trade with the other Norscan tribes!
Your men ready the longboats, loading them with spears and harpoons. Hopefully it will be enough to kill the beast.
We shall hunt the beast down! Ready the longboats!
Call back our remaining whaling vessels.
You send out word that all remaining whaling vessels are to return to the village immediately. Hopefully the beast will lose interest and wander off.
You Set sail out onto the open ocean
Set sail
todo
There is no honor in retreat.
Wolf Hunt
Word has reach you that a pack of wolves are terrorizing a local village, so the freemen demand that you uphold your oath and drive them off.
Ready my hunters!
I do this alone.
Let the rabble handle it.
Strange Tidings

Early in the morning, you and a band of your closest warriors are hunting a stag, along the way you stumble upon an idol to Tchar. Your companions are scouting ahead of you when the idol begins speaking to you, promising absolute power and dominion over all others, if you only worship him...
Tchar is known to be a trickster...
I shall be a willing servant to Tchar, Changer of Ways!
Bloody Visions

Lately, you've noticed yourself becoming more and more aggressive, and constantly craving for battle and glory. Your slumber is disturbed when Kharneth, the Blood God, demands that you join his ranks, and forever live in glory.
Glory in battle is a fine thing, but I shall earn it myself.
Yes... Yes! Blood for the Blood God!
Beautiful Voices

You are walking through your hall during a slow day. After participating in a great feast and round of drinking that would make a legendary tale in itself, you still feel empty inside, like something is missing. Soon, you begin hearing voices, beautiful ones, calling to you, asking you to give yourself to Shornaal so that you may be satisfied...
And end up a decadent sluggard? I think not!
More... More of everything!
Decay and Ruin

In your dreams Nurgleth, Lord of Death and Decay calls to you... 'The world is falling, it is corrupt, dying... embrace it, my child... embrace your destiny...' you hear a voice calling, and maggots crawl up from the ground, greeting you...
Wreck and ruin to Nurgleth, I shall make my own way!
May the corpse trail grow long!
True Evil

In your dreams, spirits of all shapes and forms come to you... You recognise many of them, and they press on you, whispering forbidden secrets and promises of power. They demand that you cast off the deities and guardians that have guided you your whole life and devote yourself entirely to the real gods of this world, the Dark Gods of Chaos Undivided: Khorne, Nurgle, Tzeentch & Slaanesh.
My oaths to my kin and my gods are too important to betray!
For the Ruinous Powers!
You have decided to abandon the traditional gods of the Norscan faith, as they have done little for you, in favour of the Chaos Gods, which shall you follow?
You have decided to choose to dedicate yourself to one of the main chaos gods, as general worship seems to have done little for you, in favour of the Chaos Gods, which shall you follow?
All of them, for the Dark Gods! For Chaos!
I feel a rage unequalled in the mortal realm... Blood for the Blood God!
Slaanesh will grant me my desires.
There are others...
Here are the others
This world reeks of death, Nurgle will see me safe.
Everyone is out to get me, but Tzeentch shall show me the way.
Nevermind.
Convert to Chaos
Embrace the Dark gods
Become Chaos Horde
Adopt the ways of the Kurgan and Hung.
Conversion
All holdings will be destroyed, providing gold and population to your horde. A Herdstone will be added to your new Nomadic capital.
All holdings will be destroyed, providing gold and population to your horde. However, some tribal buildings will be repurposed and added to your new Nomadic capital.
Choose a patron god
We pay homage to many gods... I would surely benefit by choosing one as my patron.
We Norscans worship many gods, perhaps we should adopt a single one as our patron and enjoy benefits?
Promote Tchar
Promote Kjörn
Promote Nierg
There are others...
Here are the others.
Promote Loesh
Promote Olric
